written: 2026-11-22, before any GPU run and before any tensor above N=32 at constant fraction existed
study: periodic gyroid cell refinement at constant actual solid fraction, continued with a direct solver on a rented GPU
why: The constant-fraction study of 2026-10-26 (../constant-fraction-20261026) declared N = 16, 24, 32, 48 and was refused at N=48: one CalculiX thread passed the runner's 1200 s ceiling, and multithreaded SPOOLES returned a wrong solve. On 2026-11-22 the owner asked for the carrier's remaining compute to run on rented GPUs.

unchanged_from_the_earlier_study.element: C3D8, 2 x 2 x 2 Gauss points, E = 107000 MPa (solid) or E x floor (void), nu = 0.31
unchanged_from_the_earlier_study.load: six macro strain modes of amplitude 0.001, periodic fluctuation, node (0,0,0) held
unchanged_from_the_earlier_study.case_checks: one periodic solid component; relative energy residual <= 1e-4 for each mode; relative antisymmetry <= 1e-4; normalised stiffness eigenvalues positive and at most the Voigt bound + 1e-4
unchanged_from_the_earlier_study.comparison: relative Frobenius change of the 1e-6 tensor between successive resolutions <= 0.02; void-floor change between the 1e-4 and 1e-6 tensors <= 0.01; a series is converged when its last two comparisons both pass

changed.solver: one factorisation of the assembled periodic stiffness for the six modes (rve_c3d8.py) instead of six CalculiX decks with *EQUATION; backends scipy SuperLU (CPU) and NVIDIA cuDSS through nvmath-python (GPU)
changed.time_ceiling: none per solve; the rented machine carries its own deadline

qualification_before_use.rule: a backend is admitted only if, at N = 16, 24 and 32 and both void floors, its tensor differs from the committed CalculiX tensor (../constant-fraction-20261026/results/single-thread) by at most this relative Frobenius norm
qualification_before_use.seen_before_writing: the scipy backend at N=16: 1.25e-9 (floor 1e-6) and 1.46e-9 (floor 1e-4); no GPU result existed

verdicts: declared study: converged when 24->32 and 32->48 both pass (the rule of run_constant_fraction_study.py on its own list)
extended series: converged when 48->64 and 64->80 both pass
a resolution that cannot be solved (memory, host lost) is reported as refused; it is not dropped and no other resolution is put in its place

fixed: No limit, resolution or verdict rule is changed after a tensor above N=32 is read.
The earlier fixed-threshold series (2.2369% from N=48 to 64) is not rewritten; this study answers a different question.
